_comment: #139: key derivation written by the collector and bounds accepted on read, one rule for both sides: collector/crypto.py reads this file, web/src/crypto.test.ts checks that web/src/crypto.ts says the same. Below the minimum is a downgrade (a tampered keyinfo.json or envelope); above the maximum would block the collection or freeze a phone. The written values are the minimum: the app refuses anything weaker than what the collector writes.
